businessVision: ProjectOS carries an approved programme from one phase to the next without the owner typing a command between them, and can prove it end to end.
definitionOfComplete: Two sequential proof phases execute, validate, are independently reviewed, land and close automatically, with the second depending on the first, and the programme then reports itself complete with no owner intervention after the single plan approval.
excludedScope: any ProjectOS runtime or product source file
real email, SMS or any external message
secrets, credential allowlists and trust policy
worker authority and constitutional governance records
force push, history rewrite and any merge to a protected branch
successStandard: Durable evidence shows phase two was selected automatically only after phase one closed, that phase two verified phase one landed output, and that no owner-protected effect occurred and no more than four paid review calls were made.

phases.description: Write a deterministic durable proof artefact at docs/speed/run-to-completion-proof/phase-1.md containing the exact marker RUN-TO-COMPLETION-PROOF-MARKER-8f2c1d, so that a later phase can verify it was genuinely landed rather than merely recorded as done.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/speed/run-to-completion-proof/phase-1.md exists and contains the exact marker RUN-TO-COMPLETION-PROOF-MARKER-8f2c1d.
No file outside docs/speed/run-to-completion-proof/ is created or modified by the worker.
The configured project checks run and validate-no-secrets passes.
No protected effect is performed or authorised.

phases.description: Read the landed docs/speed/run-to-completion-proof/phase-1.md, verify it carries the exact marker RUN-TO-COMPLETION-PROOF-MARKER-8f2c1d, and write docs/speed/run-to-completion-proof/phase-2.md recording the sha256 of the phase-1 file. Refuse and fail if the phase-1 artefact is absent or its marker is wrong, so the dependency on phase one is real rather than ordinal.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/speed/run-to-completion-proof/phase-1.md was read and found to contain the exact marker RUN-TO-COMPLETION-PROOF-MARKER-8f2c1d.
docs/speed/run-to-completion-proof/phase-2.md records the sha256 of the phase-1 file as it was landed.
The phase refuses rather than proceeding if the phase-1 artefact is absent or its marker does not match.
The configured project checks run and validate-no-secrets passes.
No protected effect is performed or authorised.

security.secretPolicy: No raw secret values are stored in plan memory, current state, sessions, reports or prompts. Providers are referenced by name only. Redaction is required for any sensitive value.
